name: FrenchModelVariant402_HandleRequest
evidence: matching french_model_variant/variant402_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4; for a non-negative request it selects the 20-byte config at data + 0xFC indexed by the request, gets the slot parts and packs five texture images, otherwise it runs one frame, calling the band helper from the config start, and returns the phase result; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md; notes/overlays/french-model-variant402.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the US header-385 images build the French header-402 source with the palette column 512 instead of 640. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
